question: 'Shirt' is related to 'Cloth' in the same way as 'Earring' is related to '______'.
solution:
The logic followed here is:

__
 
• **Shirt** is made up of **cloth**.

Similarly,

 
• **Earring** is made up **Gold**.

Hence, the correct answer is "Gold".

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

 
• Women - Women are the one who wear earrings.
 
• Goldsmith - A person who makes gold articles like gold earrings.
 
• **Gold -** a soft, yellow metal that is highly valued and used especially in jewelry and as a form of wealth
 
• Ear - Part of the human body, it is where earring is wore
